description: The kinds of map series the catalogue arranges (a series' kind in data/catalogue/catalogue.source.json, and a subject's seriesKind), in display order: each kind's section of the catalogue (its tab id, label and icon) and, for the kinds the filters offer, the filter's label. Read by the catalogue (packages/map/src/catalogue/index.js SECTIONS, util.js KINDS) and its check (scripts/check/rules/catalogue.mjs). Schema: packages/registries/schemas/catalogue-kinds.schema.json; views: packages/registries/src/catalogue-kinds.mjs.

kinds.meaning: historic map editions, shown as a section of their own
